title: Tigana
author: Guy Gavriel Kay
summary: Two foreign sorcerer-kings hold a peninsula of small, quarrelling provinces. One of them has wiped the name of a conquered land from every memory, and a handful of exiles set out to break the spell.
readIf: you like richly written fantasy about memory, grief and what a people owe to their own past.
skipIf: you want fast plotting or a light mood, since this is long, formal and quietly sorrowful.

pairings.reason: Another large, standalone epic with several rival powers and a cast you come to love, though with dragons and a more modern voice.
Also about a conquered people and the cost of striking back, but far bloodier and with a much harder edge.
